parameters.query:
SELECT 'pipeline_config.MAX_AMBIGUOUS_PCT_FOR_PROPOSAL' AS obj, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key='MAX_AMBIGUOUS_PCT_FOR_PROPOSAL') AS vorhanden
UNION ALL SELECT 'ux_paper_trade_events_trade_type_date', EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='trading' AND indexname='ux_paper_trade_events_trade_type_date')
UNION ALL SELECT 'ux_portfolio_risk_checks_run_ticker', EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='trading' AND indexname='ux_portfolio_risk_checks_run_ticker')
UNION ALL SELECT 'ux_stress_scenarios_run_scenario', EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='trading' AND indexname='ux_stress_scenarios_run_scenario')
UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_trade_events.business_date', EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='trading' AND table_name='paper_trade_events' AND column_name='business_date');
